description: Pylon/bridge support polygon (Hydro, 1:4k - 1:22k) is a dataset listed in LINZ Data Service (data.linz.govt.nz), New Zealand, an open data portal, published or maintained by New Zealand Hydrographic Authority. A vertical construction consisting, for example, of a steel framework or pre-stressed concrete to carry cables, a bridge, etc. S-57 Object Class: Pylon/bridge support S-57 Acronym: PYLONS This data was compiled for the use in the scale range 1:4,000 to 1:22,000. THIS DATA DOES NOT REPLACE NAUTICAL CHARTS AND MUST NOT BE USED FOR NAVIGATION. Coverage: New Zealand. The portal files it under the publisher New Zealand Hydrographic Authority. Its tags are New Zealand. It offers 1 resource(s) in vector. The portal shows 2023-04-13 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the portal's own catalogue entry (title, description, tags, licence, formats and dates) read through its API, so the data files were not opened, their contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-nz-linz-portal.
